name: Boulderland Climbing Gym
research_notes: Own site lists boulder walls, a Moon Board and spray wall, plus an 18 m lead wall; daily hours shown. Coordinates are the pin of the gym-published map link. Directory lists an older address near Sarv Square, so the gym has probably moved to the Saadatabad complex.

name: Tochal Club
address: Qaem Cultural-Sports Complex, Niyayesh Sq, Artesh Blvd, Shahrak Qaem, Tehran
research_notes: Mountaineering club whose own page presents indoor bouldering (walls to 5 m, crash pads).
